content.short: light.js is a high-level reactive JS library optimized for light clients.
content.description: Light.js, a JavaScript library from Parity Technologies, enables developers to build DApps that run efficiently on light clients. It supports Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, and Polygon, helping teams maintain high performance on light clients while avoiding the maintenance and infrastructure of full nodes. Light.js is a reactive library: developers call simple functions and the library automatically selects the most suitable pattern to handle queries behind the scenes.
